input.quote: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
input.rationale: The conformance warranty and remedies (correction, replacement, or termination with refund of prepaid fees) are sound, but the period is only 60 days from the Effective Date and is additionally cut off by a fixed calendar date, which is below our 90-day software floor and could leave almost no coverage. We extend the period to 12 months and delete the hard cut-off; 90 days is our fallback.

input.quote: 14.9 Bankruptcy. The parties hereto agree that Corio, as a licensee of Commerce One's intellectual property, shall be afforded all of the protections afforded to a licensee under Section 365(n) of the United States Bankruptcy Code
input.rationale: The agreement contains no insurance covenant at all, even though Commerce One hosts the MarketSite.net Service used by our Customers and supplies operations, consulting and engineering personnel who work with our teams. We insert a short Section 14 insurance paragraph (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, certificates on request), with E&O 1M / cyber 2M as our fallback.
